title: [Tech] Engenharia Especialista de Dados e IA
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você fará parte da área de Inteligência de Dados e IA (IDeIA), responsável pelas plataformas de dados utilizadas pelos times de produto da TOTVS.

Todos os dias, terabytes de dados de ERP passam por essas plataformas e sustentam projetos de dezenas de times internos. Do agronegócio ao varejo, da construção à saúde, esses dados apoiam a operação e a tomada de decisão de milhares de empresas brasileiras.

Nesta posição, você atuará em parceria com os times que desenvolvem nossos produtos, ajudando a transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados seguras, eficientes e escaláveis. Suas responsabilidades incluirão o desenho técnico das soluções, a revisão de arquiteturas, o apoio na resolução de questões técnicas e a identificação de oportunidades de evolução das plataformas.

A atuação é principalmente consultiva. Os times de produtos internos conduzem a implementação, enquanto você orienta as decisões arquiteturais, compartilha boas práticas e contribui para ampliar o uso de dados e IA nas soluções TOTVS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir o onboarding de novos times nas plataformas de dados;
  • Elaborar desenhos técnicos em conjunto com os times e revisar a arquitetura dos projetos;
  • Orientar engenheiros na resolução de dúvidas por chat, chamados e videochamadas;
  • Acompanhar soluções, considerando custo, desempenho, confiabilidade e experiência de uso;
  • Criar automações e agentes de apoio que ampliem a autonomia dos usuários das plataformas;
  • Disseminar boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia de dados e uso responsável de IA;
  • Propor evoluções e melhorias para as plataformas com base nos aprendizados da operação;
  • Construir e sustentar pipelines de dados batch e streaming em produção;
  • Atuar com orquestração de cargas, tratamento de falhas, monitoramento e rastreabilidade;
  • Integrar dados por meio de APIs e sistemas de mensageria, considerando a consistência dos dados;
  • Definir estratégias de cargas completas e incrementais;
  • Apoiar a definição da camada de consumo considerando volume, latência e custo;
  • Disponibilizar dados por APIs REST, MCP ou ferramentas de BI;
  • Atuar na gestão e otimização de custos em nuvem, incluindo análise de billing e utilização de recursos;
  • Apoiar a aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, autenticação, autorização e controle de acesso;
  • Atuar com segurança e isolamento de dados entre clientes em ambientes multi-tenant;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem para ingestão, processamento e consumo de dados;
  • Experiência com modelagem dimensional e arquiteturas de dados em camadas;
  • Conhecimento de data warehouses, bancos de dados de baixa latência e mecanismos de cache;
  • Experiência com pipelines batch e streaming em produção;
  • Conhecimento de APIs REST, sistemas de mensageria e integração de dados;
  • Conhecimento de autenticação, autorização e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade para analisar diferentes cenários e orientar decisões arquiteturais;
  • Capacidade para discutir arquitetura com engenheiros e sustentar recomendações técnicas;
  • Comunicação escrita clara, estruturada e adequada a diferentes públicos;
  • Autonomia para investigar problemas e propor soluções;
  • Pensamento crítico para identificar oportunidades de automação e aprimorar a experiência de uso;
  • Inglês para leitura e compreensão de documentação técnica;
  • Conhecimentos em GCP, especialmente BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Pub/Sub e Dataflow;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL, Python e JavaScript (Node.js);
  • Conhecimentos em APIs REST, MCP e DuckDB;
  • Conhecimentos em Looker Studio ou ferramentas de BI e visualização;
  • Conhecimentos em Jenkins e GitHub Actions;
  • Conhecimentos em Terraform e Git;
  • Conhecimentos em Jira e Zendesk;
  • Conhecimentos ou experiência com Gemini e OpenAI (Codex).

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Atuação em plataformas de dados que atendam times internos;

  • Experiência com otimização de consultas por meio de particionamento, clusterização e controle de custos;

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Politics
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Politics Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in politics and political science will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse political topics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering political science, governance, elections, public policy, international relations, political systems, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, neutrality, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, bias, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous, sensitive, or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, Government, Public Administration, Law, Economics, Journalism, or other politics-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of politics, including political systems, governance, elections, public policy, international relations, political institutions, comparative politics, and current global political developments.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in public policy, government, political research, political consulting, academia, journalism, international affairs, think tanks, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate political information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a wide range of political and public policy topics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong understanding of political systems, governance, elections, public policy, international relations, and current political developments.
  • Ability to provide objective, impartial, and evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Controller
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.

We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence, satisfy its auditors, raise its next round, and scale.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Controller to own the accounting function of a high-growth US company, working remotely from LATAM.

This is the senior accounting seat in the business. You will be accountable for the integrity of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of the company for its audit. Where the company has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a control environment that exists in principle rather than in practice, an intercompany process that produces a different answer each quarter — you will be the person who rebuilds them.

You will work directly with the CEO, the finance leadership, and the department heads whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask.

Because you will be the most senior accounting person in the company and located outside the United States, the role calls for someone who operates well with autonomy, communicates proactively rather than on request, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture without a layer above them to catch what falls through.

What You'll Own

The Close and the Financial Statements

The close. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.

The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of leadership, auditors, and the board.

Final review. Hold final review authority over general ledger activity, journal entries, account reconciliations, and fixed assets.

Technical accounting. Research, document, and conclude on technical positions — revenue recognition, leases, equity, accruals, and capitalisation — and maintain the memoranda that support them.

Multi-entity accounting. Own consolidation across the group structure, including intercompany accounting, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to the company's stage, and enforce them once established.

Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and SOPs that allow the function to operate without depending on any single individual.

Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.

Tax coordination. Coordinate US federal, state, and local tax compliance with external CPA firms, and own the accounting inputs those firms depend on.

Accounting Operations

The transactional cycle. Own AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.

Balance sheet integrity. Ensure reconciling items are resolved rather than carried forward, and that every balance has support a reviewer can follow.

Cash reporting. Maintain accurate cash reporting and reconciliation, and provide leadership with a reliable view of position and movement.

Business partnership. Provide FP&A and department leaders with the reporting packages, KPIs, variance analysis, and root-cause explanation that budgeting and forecasting depend on.

Team and Systems

The accounting team. Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team, and manage external accounting and bookkeeping partners against agreed standards and deadlines.

Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.

Process design. Build accounting processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and cycle time as the company grows, rather than processes that break at the next stage.

What We're Looking For

  • 8–10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of an accounting team
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842); familiarity with stock-based compensation (ASC 718) is an advantage
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks Online, or Xero, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Rippling, Gusto, or FloQast
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; Power BI or comparable reporting tools an advantage
  • Experience acting as the senior accounting partner to executive leadership, including presenting results and defending conclusions
  • Comfort operating within a lean team, with the seniority to own the function and the willingness to prepare the entry yourself when circumstances require it
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Preferred

  • CPA, Contador Público, CRC-registered Contador, CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS, professional services, or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR
  • Board, lender, and management reporting experience
  • Exposure to US multi-state tax, international entities, or transfer pricing is welcome

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own a function outright rather than administer one part of it.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you, and you are equally credible in a room with a CEO, an auditor, and a junior accountant.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

Own an entire accounting function, end to end, with direct exposure to founders and senior leadership

Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's

Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities

Sit close to the decisions that depend on your numbers, with visible impact on the outcome

Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI

Work remotely with US-based leadership, in substantial overlap with the US business day

Receive MAVI's support throughout placement, onboarding, and the engagement that follows

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role. You will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners, and you will be placed with a single client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts.

Candidates based in LATAM will maintain near-full overlap with the US business day. Candidates based in India should expect a structured afternoon-to-evening schedule providing a firm overlap against US Eastern hours.

title: Ombudsman / Ouvidor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is looking for a qualified Ombudsman (Ouvidor) to manage the mandatory Ouvidoria structure for our regulated VASP entity under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025, Resolution BCB No. 28/2021, and CMN Resolution No. 4,860/2020.

Serving as the second-instance escalation mechanism, the Ombudsman acts independently from operational and sales teams, championing client rights and reporting systemic insights directly to top management.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Second-Instance Complaints: Receive, register, and resolve complex client complaints escalated from standard customer service (SAC) within mandatory BCB resolution timeframes.
  • Independent Mediation: Act as an impartial mediator between clients and internal operational units.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Identify recurring operational failures or systemic compliance risks and recommend corrective action plans to executive leadership.
  • BCB & Board Reporting: Prepare periodic Ombudsman reports (Relatório de Ouvidoria) detailing complaint volume, resolution metrics, and root cause analyses for internal governance and BCB regulatory filings.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven background in Client Advocacy, Ombudsman (Ouvidoria), Legal, or Regulatory Compliance within BCB-regulated financial institutions, payments, or crypto platforms.
  • Consumer Law: Solid working knowledge of the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (Código de Defesa do Consumidor - CDC) and BCB Ouvidoria regulations.
  • Certifications: Active Ombudsman Certification (Certificação de Ouvidoria by Anbima, Febraban, or Abecip), required.
  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory) and professional working English (preferred).

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory Compliance & Dispute Resolution: Deep understanding of BCB consumer protection frameworks, Resolution BCB 28/2021, CMN 4,860/2020, and the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (CDC).
  • Executive Presence: Ability to act as an autonomous authority, presenting independent semi-annual Ombudsman reports (Relatórios de Ouvidoria) to the Board of Directors and BCB examiners.
  • Strong Analytical & Root-Cause Analysis Skills: Capability to analyze complaint data, identify recurring product/operational bottlenecks, and drive structural recommendations.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Strong commitment to meeting strict regulatory response deadlines (BCB SLA requirements) and managing regulatory exposure.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mediation: Proven ability to liaise neutrally between aggrieved customers, internal business lines, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams.
  • Ability to build scalable dispute resolution infrastructure: Capacity to design and scale second-instance ticketing systems, automated SLA tracking, and complaint reporting workflows tailored for fast-growing financial platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Fintech & Cross-Border Experience: Background handling complex customer grievances related to international wire transfers, eFX exchange rates, Pix transactions, or digital asset settlements.
  • BACEN Reporting Exposure: Prior experience inputting data into or submitting regulatory complaint reports through official BCB reporting portals (Unifoco/RDR).
  • Legal/Regulatory Background: Formal education or background in Legal, Consumer Law, or Compliance within regulated financial institutions (IPs/SDFs/VASPs) in Brasil.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Production Engineer - Wireless Industrialization and Tax Processes Specialist
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Production Engineer or Industrialization Specialist to support the development and implementation of local manufacturing and assembly strategies for ZTE's telecommunications products in Brazil.

The primary focus of this position will be to evaluate and enable the local production of Wireless RAN and Microwave (MW) equipment, including radio units, baseband units, antennas, transmission equipment, cabinets, power systems, accessories, and related components.

This professional will act as a key interface among Engineering, Product Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Logistics, Finance, local manufacturing partners, and ZTE's global teams.

The position requires a combination of industrial engineering, product-cost analysis, tax knowledge, and project coordination. The professional will be responsible for developing feasible local-production models, ensuring compliance with Brazilian industrial and tax regulations, and evaluating the effects of the Brazilian Tax Reform on manufacturing costs, tax credits, sourcing strategies, and product competitiveness.

Main Responsibilities

Local Production and Industrialization

  • Evaluate Wireless RAN and Microwave product families for potential local manufacturing, assembly, integration, configuration, testing, and repair in Brazil.
  • Develop industrialization strategies for radio units, baseband equipment, antennas, microwave radios, indoor and outdoor units, cabinets, power systems, and related telecom products.
  • Analyze different production models, including local manufacturing, outsourced manufacturing, contract manufacturing, CKD/SKD assembly, and partial localization of components.
  • Coordinate the implementation of local production projects from feasibility study through pilot production and mass production.
  • Define production workflows, assembly sequences, testing procedures, quality checkpoints, required tooling, labor demand, and factory capacity.
  • Prepare industrial process flowcharts, work instructions, technical reports, and project documentation.
  • Support prototype, pilot, first-article, and production-validation activities.
  • Monitor production performance, lead time, yield, quality indicators, manufacturing costs, and corrective-action plans.

Product Localization and Cost Analysis

  • Review product BOMs to identify opportunities for local sourcing, component substitution, process simplification, and cost reduction.
  • Develop localization roadmaps for selected Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Perform make-or-buy analyses and compare imported-product costs with local-production scenarios.
  • Prepare business cases covering investment requirements, production volume, manufacturing costs, tax impacts, logistics costs, and expected financial returns.
  • Identify Brazilian suppliers and manufacturing partners capable of meeting ZTE's technical, quality, cost, capacity, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate technical alignment between Brazilian suppliers, outsourced factories, and ZTE's global R&D and product teams.
  • Support negotiations with contract manufacturers and monitor their operational and contractual performance.

PPB, Regulatory Compliance and Incentives

  • Analyze and implement applicable Basic Productive Process (PPB) requirements for telecommunications and electronic products.
  • Evaluate industrial and regional incentive structures, including projects involving SUFRAMA and the Manaus Free Trade Zone, when applicable.
  • Monitor compliance with production stages, local-content requirements, investment commitments, documentation, and traceability obligations.
  • Support applications, technical projects, reports, and evidence required by government authorities and incentive programs.
  • Ensure alignment among BOM structure, manufacturing processes, import records, production orders, inventories, and tax documentation.
  • Support ANATEL-related product-compliance activities when they interact with industrialization, local configuration, or product modifications.
  • Assist internal and external audits and inspections conducted by SUFRAMA, Receita Federal, SEFAZ, and other regulatory authorities.

Tax Processes and Brazilian Tax Reform

  • Evaluate the tax impacts of local production versus importation for Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Support the correct classification of products, components, kits, and raw materials under the NCM.
  • Coordinate the preparation and validation of the FCI – Import Content Statement, when applicable.
  • Work closely with the Tax team to ensure the correct application and recovery of tax credits throughout the manufacturing and supply chain.
  • Analyze the effects of Brazil's Tax Reform on industrialization projects, particularly the transition from the current tax system to CBS and IBS.
  • Assess how the new tax-credit model may affect product costs, local sourcing, contract manufacturing, inventory flows, transfers, imports, sales, and customer pricing.
  • Monitor the coexistence of legacy taxes and the new consumption-tax system during the transition period.
  • Support adaptations to ERP, costing, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, and tax-control processes required by the Tax Reform.
  • Analyze the effects of ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, CBS, IBS and, when applicable, the Selective Tax and regional tax incentives on industrial projects.
  • Maintain documentation and calculation models that allow ZTE to compare tax burdens and credit utilization under different production and sourcing scenarios.
  • Work with Tax, Finance, IT, and ERP teams to ensure the traceability of tax credits from component acquisition through production and final sale.
  • Monitor regulatory changes that may affect PPB rules, Manaus Free Trade Zone incentives, local manufacturing, imported content, or telecom-equipment taxation.

Systems, Inventory and Process Integration

  • Support the configuration and continuous improvement of industrial, inventory, purchasing, costing, and tax processes in ERP systems.
  • Ensure consistency among engineering BOMs, production BOMs, purchase orders, import systems, warehouse balances, production orders, and accounting records.
  • Support integrations and reconciliations involving PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, import-management systems, and other internal platforms.
  • Identify process gaps that may generate incorrect inventory balances, tax-credit losses, production delays, or accounting inconsistencies.
  • Participate in automation, data-analysis, and artificial-intelligence initiatives aimed at improving industrial planning, tax controls, documentation, and operational productivity.

Project Management and Cross-functional Coordination

  • Lead cross-functional industrialization projects involving Engineering, Product, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Finance, Logistics, Quality, IT, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Develop project schedules, define responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and report risks and progress to management.
  • Coordinate technical and commercial discussions with ZTE headquarters and international product teams.
  • Translate global product and manufacturing requirements into processes compatible with Brazilian industrial, tax, and regulatory conditions.
  • Present recommendations, business cases, risks, and project results to local and global leadership.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production-process implementation, or local assembly of electronic or telecommunications products.
  • Experience with BOM analysis, production workflows, cost structures, and outsourced manufacturing.
  • Practical knowledge of Brazilian taxes and industrial regulations related to manufacturing, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, NCM, FCI, and PPB.
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its main operational impacts, especially CBS, IBS, tax-credit traceability, and the transition between tax systems.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including cost simulations, scenario analysis, reconciliations, and data processing.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering specifications, BOMs, production documents, tax legislation, and regulatory requirements.
  • Intermediate or advanced English for meetings, technical discussions, documentation, and interaction with ZTE's global teams.
  • Availability to visit suppliers, factories, warehouses, and production partners when required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Wireless RAN, Microwave, telecommunications infrastructure, or radio-frequency equipment.
  • Knowledge of the architecture and main components of radio access and microwave-transmission systems.
  • Previous experience in the localization or nationalization of telecom or electronic products.
  • Experience with contract manufacturers, electronics manufacturing services, CKD/SKD operations, or outsourced assembly.
  • Experience with PPB projects, SUFRAMA, the Manaus Free Trade Zone, or other Brazilian industrial-incentive programs.
  • Knowledge of PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, MES, PLM, or other ERP and manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with product-costing methodologies, standard cost, landed cost, and manufacturing variance analysis.
  • Experience with ANATEL certification processes or other telecom regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, process mapping, quality tools, or project-management methodologies.
  • Experience using business-intelligence, automation, data-analysis, or artificial-intelligence tools.
  • Knowledge of Mandarin Chinese will be considered an advantage.

Requirement:

  • 7 years of experience in implementation in production, quality, supply chain, industrialization and tax;
  • Graduated in Engineering;
  • Fluent English.

title: Senior Accounting Manager
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.

The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.

You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

  • The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced.
  • Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on.
  • Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review.
  • Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

  • Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you.
  • Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller.
  • External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations and Team

  • The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast.
  • The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or Rippling
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

  • Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them
  • Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI
  • Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Science & Technology
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Science & Technology Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in science and technology will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of scientific and technological topics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, and related fields.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, technical correctness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or technically complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or other science and technology-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of science and technology, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering principles, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, scientific research, and recent technological advancements.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in scientific research, engineering, technology, software development, academia, technical writing, science journalism, data science, AI, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Sports
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Preferred Qualifications

title: Product Designer Mobile & Web | Remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We're expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We're looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude. You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you've been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.

The role

You'll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You'll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

  • Product discovery and exploring new ideas
  • Turning early ideas into clear user journeys
  • Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems
  • Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs
  • Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing
  • Designing across iOS, Android and web
  • Working with and improving our design systems
  • Working closely with developers throughout implementation
  • Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users
  • Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There's a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.

What matters to us

Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don't quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won't always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you'll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there's a better way of doing it.

We're a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.

We're looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work. The job doesn't finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.

What we're looking for

  • Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer
  • A strong portfolio showing real digital products you've worked on
  • Experience designing for mobile and web
  • Good understanding of iOS and Android UX patterns
  • Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping
  • Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing
  • Experience working with design systems
  • Comfortable working closely with developers
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work
  • Very strong attention to detail
  • Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table
  • Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly
  • Fluent English, written and spoken

The setup

  • Remote
  • Contractor / PJ
  • Monday to Friday
  • The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time, so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions
  • Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible

Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

title: Head of Accounting
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.

We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.

The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.

You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

  • The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors.
  • Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.
  • Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

  • Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual.
  • Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.
  • External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

  • The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.

Team, Systems, and Standard

  • Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.
  • A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Rippling, or FloQast
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

  • Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat
  • Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI
  • Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Analista de suporte comercial

title: Mecânico de manutenção de máquinas pesadas
description:
Descrição de Cargo: Mecânico de manutenção de máquinas pesadas

Nível: Operacional / Técnico

Objetivo do Cargo:

Executar manutenções preventivas, corretivas e preditivas em frotas e equipamentos pesados de linha amarela e transporte (tratores, pás carregadeiras, retroescavadeiras, escavadeiras e caminhões).

Garantir a máxima disponibilidade operacional dos equipamentos no processo de movimentação, carregamento e armazenagem de fertilizantes, respeitando as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança do trabalho.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Manutenção Preventiva e Corretiva: Diagnosticar, reparar e substituir componentes mecânicos, hidráulicos, pneumáticos e elétricos de máquinas de linha amarela e caminhões da planta.
  • Operação de Sistemas Didáticos e Diagnóstico: Utilizar rastreadores e ferramentas de diagnóstico eletrônico para identificar falhas em motores a diesel, transmissões automáticas/powershift e sistemas hidráulicos de alta pressão.
  • Preservação Contra Ambientes Agressivos: Executar inspeções e aplicação de tratamentos protetivos em chassis, articulações e conectores elétricos expostos ao pó e à corrosão severa de fertilizantes (como ureia, KCI e fosfatos).
  • Testes e Liberação: Realizar testes de rodagem, aferição de pressão de sistemas hidráulicos e regulagens técnicas antes da liberação final do equipamento para a operação.
  • Registro e Controle: Preencher ordens de serviço (OS) em sistema de gestão da manutenção (CMMS/SAP/TOTVS), detalhando causas, peças aplicadas e horas trabalhadas.
  • Segurança e Organização: Cumprir rigorosamente procedimentos de LOTO (Bloqueio e Etiquetagem) durante manutenções, manter a oficina limpa e zelar pelo descarte correto de óleos e fluídos contaminados.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo + Curso Técnico em Mecânica, Electromecânica ou Manutenção de Automotores.

Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos atuando com manutenção de máquinas pesadas (linha amarela e caminhões).

Conhecimentos Técnicos: Leituras de esquemas hidráulicos e elétricos; manutenção de motores a diesel; sistemas de freio e transmissão. Certificações & CNH CNH categoria D ou E; Certificação para operação de máquinas (desejável NR-11 e NR-12).

Diferencial: Experiência anterior em indústrias químicas, de fertilizantes, mineração ou agronegócio.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Foco em Segurança: Rigor inegociável com normas de proteção individual e coletiva.
  • Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade para investigação estruturada de causaraiz de falhas mecânicas.
  • Proatividade e Agilidade: Resposta rápida a paradas não programadas para evitar gargalos na produção/embarque.

title: Advogado Tributário Sênior
description:
Na ArcelorMittal acreditamos que uma escolha de carreira vai além da posição, é sobre fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza pessoas, promove o desenvolvimento contínuo e, acima de tudo, coloca a Segurança como um valor inegociável em todas as decisões.

A seguir, você encontrará mais detalhes sobre a ArcelorMittal, a oportunidade, o que oferecemos e o que buscamos nas pessoas que querem construir essa jornada conosco.

Quem somos

Somos a ArcelorMittal, maior produtora de aço do Brasil e uma empresa global que atua com o propósito de produzir aços inteligentes para as pessoas e para o planeta. Somos uma organização que evolui continuamente, impulsionada por pessoas, inovação e pela busca constante por soluções mais eficientes e sustentáveis. A ArcelorMittal é uma das principais empresas integradas de aço e mineração do mundo, com operações em 60 países e produção primária de aço em 15. Com mais de 125.000 empregados no mundo, atendemos clientes em diversos setores, como automotivo, construção, energia e engenharia. Nossos produtos fazem parte do dia a dia, causando um impacto positivo em indivíduos, comunidades e na sociedade.

Na nossa cultura, as pessoas estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos e é por isso que a Segurança, nosso valor fundamental, orienta nossas ações, decisões e a forma como trabalhamos todos os dias.

Fazer parte da ArcelorMittal é integrar um ambiente em constante transformação, onde:

A segurança e o cuidado com as pessoas vêm sempre em primeiro lugar

  • A inovação e a tecnologia são aplicadas para gerar valor com responsabilidade
  • O aprendizado é contínuo, com desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento
  • A diversidade de perspectivas fortalece nossas decisões e resultados

Buscamos pessoas que queiram evoluir junto com a empresa, contribuindo de forma responsável, colaborativa e comprometida com resultados sustentáveis.

Você será responsável por:

  • Gerenciar carteira de processos e contingências tributárias, incluindo avaliação de risco, provisões, indicadores de desempenho e reporte à liderança.
  • Elaborar pareceres, opiniões legais e consultas tributárias envolvendo tributos federais, estaduais e municipais.
  • Prestar consultoria tributária às áreas de negócio, finanças, contabilidade, fiscal, suprimentos, comercial e demais clientes internos, apoiando a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Conduzir análises de riscos tributários, estudos de impacto e revisão de operações, identificando oportunidades de otimização tributária e mitigação de contingências.
  • Suporte ao atendimento de fiscalizações, perícias e auditorias tributárias, coordenando a produção de informações e esclarecimentos.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar teses tributárias relevantes, monitorando alterações legislativas, jurisprudenciais e leading cases com potencial impacto para a companhia.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Direito;
  • OAB ativa;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência sólida em consultoria e contencioso tributário;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de tributos federais, estaduais e municipais;
  • Vivência em ambiente corporativo de grande porte ou escritórios.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em direito tributário;
  • Formação em ciências contábeis e experiência em Big Four.

Benefícios:

  • Contamos com um pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Programa de Participação de Resultados/Remuneração Variável.
  • Retorno de férias.
  • Horário Flexível.
  • Opção do plano Previdência Privada.
  • Kit Escolar: Anualmente, a empresa distribui material escolar para os filhos dos empregados, de acordo com o nível de escolaridade e a faixa etária (de 3 a 18 anos).
  • Kit de Natal para nossos empregados e suas famílias.

Como funciona nosso processo seletivo?

Nosso processo seletivo é conduzido de forma estruturada, transparente e respeitosa, considerando tanto aspectos técnicos quanto a aderência à nossa cultura. Ao longo da jornada, buscamos conhecer não apenas suas experiências, mas também como você se conecta com ambientes que valorizam:

  • Segurança

title: Analista de Logística Pleno
description:
Ei, que bom te ver por aqui!

Você já conhece a ZAMP?

Somos um grande ecossistema de restaurantes que reúne marcas internacionais como Burger King®, Popeyes®, Starbucks® e Subway®.

E, por trás de cada receita de sucesso, estão os Zampers: gente que faz acontecer, que joga junto e que deixa sua marca todos os dias.

Aqui, a gente acredita que o verdadeiro sabor do sucesso é ter espaço pra criar, crescer, liderar e ser quem você é. Usamos tecnologia, inovação e muita parceria para entregar experiências que surpreendem nossos clientes e geram oportunidades para o nosso time. Temos apetite pelo futuro e ousadia para conquistar novos mercados, novos sabores e novas conexões. Porque grandes marcas só existem quando grandes pessoas constroem algo maior do que elas mesmas.

Isso é a Zamp®: um ecossistema de restaurantes e pessoas em constante evolução.

*Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

Como será o seu desafio?

  • Atuar como elo entre as lojas, o operador logístico e as áreas internas, garantindo uma comunicação clara, ágil e orientada à solução;
  • Acompanhar a operação logística da marca, identificando desvios e atuando junto ao operador logístico para garantir a disponibilidade de produtos nas lojas;
  • Analisar indicadores e resultados da operação logística, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo planos de ação;
  • Interpretar dados e informações de diferentes fontes, utilizando Excel e Power BI para gerar análises e apoiar a tomada de decisão;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de transporte, armazenagem, nível de serviço, OTIF, entrega completa e demais KPIs logísticos;
  • Investigar problemas operacionais, entender causas e impactos e conduzir a resolução junto aos parceiros logísticos;
  • Realizar a interface com diferentes níveis de liderança, incluindo gerentes e diretores, apresentando informações, riscos, resultados e planos de ação;
  • Demonstrar senso de urgência, dinamismo e flexibilidade diante de situações críticas ou mudanças no cenário operacional;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na identificação de problemas, antecipando riscos e buscando soluções antes que os impactos cheguem às lojas;
  • Exercer liderança informal, mobilizando diferentes pessoas e áreas para solucionar problemas e garantir a execução das ações;
  • Realizar visitas pontuais a operações e operadores logísticos, conforme necessidade do negócio.

Ingredientes Para o Combo:

  • Ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em logística, transporte, armazenagem ou operações de Supply Chain;
  • Conhecimento dos principais processos e indicadores logísticos, incluindo OTIF, nível de serviço, entrega completa, transporte e armazenagem;
  • Experiência com análise de indicadores e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e Power BI;
  • Vivência na interface com operadores logísticos, transportadoras e/ou áreas operacionais;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de interagir com diferentes públicos e níveis hierárquicos;
  • Perfil proativo, dinâmico, resolutivo e com forte senso de urgência;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em cenários dinâmicos, com flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças e situações críticas;
  • Perfil analítico, com autonomia para identificar problemas, investigar causas e propor soluções.

Diferenciais que fazem a diferença:

  • Experiência em varejo, food service, indústria de alimentos, bebidas ou operações de grande escala;
  • Experiência com gestão ou interface direta com operadores logísticos;
  • Vivência em ambientes com alta complexidade operacional e necessidade de rápida tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados;
  • Experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua e desenvolvimento de planos de ação;
  • Perfil de liderança informal, com capacidade de mobilizar pessoas e influenciar diferentes áreas;
  • Interesse e potencial para evolução para posições de maior senioridade.

title: Analista de Licitações

Mais bonificação por êxito a cada contrato que a Argus vencer com o seu trabalho. Aqui a licitação ganha não vira só meta batida em relatório, vira dinheiro no seu bolso além do salário. A regra é aberta e explicada na entrevista, sem letra miúda.

Procuramos quem já opera licitação pública do lado do licitante, no detalhe, com o rigor de quem não pode errar habilitação, planilha ou prazo.

O trabalho é presencial e manual. Do primeiro item do edital até a homologação.

Essa pessoa também é a referência humana de um sistema de agentes de IA em construção: leitura de edital, cruzamento com a lei, impugnação, planilha, proposta, chat com pregoeiro, recurso e diligência. Se o sistema errar, é o analista quem aponta o erro e devolve o padrão certo. Não é vaga de engenheiro de software. É vaga de quem sabe o ofício e consegue ensinar a máquina.

Sobre a empresa

Prestadora de serviços contínuos em contratos públicos (limpeza, portaria, apoio, manutenção predial leve, motoristas e mão de obra terceirizada), com atuação em vários Estados. A base desta vaga é fixa em Piedade, sem necessidade de deslocamento.

Jornada e benefícios

  • Bonificação por êxito a cada contrato ganho
  • Segunda a quinta das 8h às 18h, sexta das 8h às 17h, com 1h de almoço
  • Vale-transporte ou cartão combustível
  • Vale-alimentação de R$ 30,00 por dia
  • Plano de saúde com coparticipação

O que você vai fazer

  • Prospectar e priorizar oportunidades nos setores da empresa
  • Ler edital, TR, anexos e minuta do primeiro ao último item
  • Cruzar com a Lei 14.133/2021, Lei 13.303/2016 (quando estatal), IN 05/2017 e Caderno de Logística
  • Redigir e protocolar esclarecimento, impugnação e recurso
  • Montar e conferir planilha IN 05 (módulos 1 a 6, encargos, insumos, tributo por dentro, FAP/RAT, VT, benefícios)
  • Cadastrar proposta e operar a sessão nos portais
  • Responder diligência, sanar habilitação e acompanhar adjudicação e homologação
  • Manter certidões, atestados e credenciamento vivos
  • Revisar a saída dos agentes de IA e documentar o raciocínio certo

Requisitos

  • Lei 14.133 na prática (fases, habilitação, julgamento, recurso, diligência)
  • Planilha de terceirização IN 05 de verdade
  • Conta vinculada, repactuação e CCT da categoria
  • Compras.gov / ComprasNet, PNCP, SICAF e pelo menos dois portais equivalentes
  • Peça formal protocolável
  • Excel avançado para conferir a planilha módulo a módulo
  • Habilitação na vida real: atestado, índices, regularidade fiscal e trabalhista

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresa prestadora de serviços contínuos
  • Pregão de limpeza, portaria ou mão de obra até o lance
  • Conlicitação ou radar equivalente
  • Noção de Lucro Real vs Presumido no módulo tributário
  • Já usa IA no trabalho (Claude, ChatGPT e afins), sem precisar programar

O que esta vaga não é

Não é home office. Não é estágio. Não é "acompanhar ComprasNet". Não entra quem inventa UASG, chute de custo indireto e lucro ou planilha que não fecha com o TR.

Para se candidatar

Use o botão de candidatura desta vaga. Na sua mensagem, responda em no máximo 15 linhas: anos na função, portais que opera, se já montou planilha IN 05, se já protocolou impugnação ou recurso, e um pregão concreto (órgão, objeto, resultado). Mantenha o currículo atualizado no seu perfil.

Reforçando: R$ 4.000,00 a R$ 6.000,00 conforme a senioridade comprovada, mais bonificação por êxito a cada contrato ganho.

title: Analista de Geoprocessamento

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Geoprocessamento para atuar com inteligência geográfica, análise e tratamento de dados geoespaciais, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas junto à Operação. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coletar, tratar, analisar e validar dados geoespaciais provenientes de diferentes fontes, como GIS, imagens de satélite, GPS, drones, bases cartográficas e sistemas corporativos.
  • Atualizar, manter e controlar a qualidade das bases geográficas e dos cadastros técnicos, incluindo o sistema SIGNOS da Sabesp, garantindo a integridade, confiabilidade, consistência e disponibilidade das informações geoespaciais.
  • Elaborar mapas temáticos, mapas técnicos, dashboards geográficos, relatórios, gráficos e layouts cartográficos para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Executar análises espaciais para diagnóstico, identificação de padrões, modelagem territorial, modelagem de redes, definição e delimitação de áreas de atuação, bem como estudos de rotas.
  • Realizar georreferenciamento de imagens, pontos de interesse, redes e ativos de infraestrutura.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e plataformas de geoprocessamento, como ArcGIS, QGIS, AutoCAD Map e demais soluções geoespaciais.
  • Apoiar projetos de universalização, regularização cadastral, gestão patrimonial, planejamento de investimentos e iniciativas relacionadas ao saneamento, meio ambiente e desenvolvimento urbano.
  • Integrar informações geográficas com indicadores operacionais, comerciais, regulatórios, patrimoniais e de engenharia.
  • Apoiar equipes multidisciplinares na elaboração de estudos, projetos e soluções baseadas em inteligência geográfica.
  • Aplicar normas técnicas, ambientais e legais relacionadas ao uso e à gestão de dados geoespaciais.
  • Participar de iniciativas de transformação digital, automação de processos e governança de dados geográficos.
  • Apresentar análises, estudos, indicadores e resultados geoespaciais em reuniões técnicas e executivas, apoiando o acompanhamento de projetos e a tomada de decisão.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Cartográfica, Engenharia de Agrimensura, Geografia, Geoprocessamento, Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental, Tecnologia em Geoprocessamento ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas de Informações Geográficas (SIG/GIS).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de geoprocessamento, preferencialmente ArcGIS.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI integrado a dados geoespaciais.
  • Conhecimento em análise espacial, cartografia e georreferenciamento.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados geográficos e manipulação de dados espaciais.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Obrigatório Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) Categoria B.

Competências desejadas

  • Visão analítica e pensamento sistêmico, transformando dados geográficos em informações estratégicas para o negócio.
  • Proatividade, inovação e foco em melhoria contínua dos processos e da qualidade dos dados.
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a governança das informações.
  • Capacidade de relacionamento e trabalho colaborativo com equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com geodatabases, PostgreSQL/PostGIS ou SQL Server.
  • Experiência com automação utilizando Python para geoprocessamento.
  • Conhecimento em sensoriamento remoto, imagens de satélite e drones.
  • Experiência em projetos de cadastro técnico, gestão de ativos ou espacialização de ligações.
